Requirements You are about to cast a spell that inflicts damage.

Your catalysts can introduce a wrinkle in your crafted magic, one that leaves an enemy reeling. When you cast your catalyzed spell and it deals damage, your target gains weakness 5 to the type of damage your spell inflicts for 1 minute. If it deals multiple damage types, choose one. If the spell targets multiple enemies or inflicts damage in an area, choose one target.

Visionary Catalyst Your catalyst allows you to truly elevate your magic. You can either increase the weakness you inflict against a single target to 10, or you can inflict weakness 5 on any creature you damage with your spell, picking the same damage type for all creatures if it deals multiple.
